result.topic_en: For the case A−B negative, Gauss lists the lower and upper bounds for X in terms of Y°, A, B, D according to the size of Y°, and tabulates for two numerical examples the bounds and the integer values of X° lying between them.
result.transcription:
II. Wenn $A-B$ negativ ist
Wenn | [-zwischen-]{+zwischen+} | und
$Y^0 < \frac{1}{2}A$ | $-\frac{BY^0}{A}$ | $\frac{AY^0}{B}$
$Y > \frac{1}{2}A$ und $< \frac{1}{2}B$ | $+\frac{AY^0}{B}-\frac{D}{2B}$ | $\frac{AY^0}{B}$
$Y = \frac{1}{2}B$ | [-$\frac{AB}{2B}$ $\frac{AY^0}{B}$-] $\frac{AB-D}{2B}$ | $\frac{1}{2}A$
$Y > \frac{1}{2}B$ | $\frac{AY^0}{B}-\frac{D}{2B}$ | $-\frac{BY^0}{A}+\frac{D}{2A}$
Jn den kleinern Grenzen ist entweder $\xi=0$ oder $\eta=\frac{1}{2}$
